extraction.Name: Jesse Wright
extraction.NOTES: Got patent from the Farmers office at Okreek a long time ago but does not remember the date. Received $3600.00 and a stallion (total stated as $4000.00) for the land. Did not ask for the patent. Satisfied with the sale. Did not owe the man he sold the land anything. Has seven children, supports five of them. Notarized by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, May 7, 1929.
